description: This visual provides a modern and highly aesthetic alternative to traditional Power BI bar charts. Designed for report creators who value design, it stands out with its ability to create bars with rounded corners (adjustable radius), offering a softer and more contemporary look, perfect for executive dashboards or clean user interfaces. Beyond aesthetics, this visual offers granular control over layout and typography. You can fully customize the appearance of data labels (font, color, size, decimals, or percentage format) as well as the X-axis, including label rotation to avoid overlapping. Managing bar spacing and width allows you to perfectly adapt the chart to the available space. Easy to use, it requires only a category and a measure to work instantly. It also includes integrated title options and background management, making this visual a complete tool for presenting your Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) with clarity and elegance.
